credit_metrics.text: EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}}, and operating profit rose by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}} despite higher depreciation charges.
Total debt was broadly unchanged at {{total_debt@FY2025}} and net debt stable at {{net_debt@FY2025}}, so gross leverage fell by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}.

FFO rose by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, lifting FFO to debt by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}}, and interest coverage improved by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2025}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2025}}.

Free cash flow increased by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}}, taking FCF to debt up by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}, with capex intensity easing by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and cash liquidity declined by {{cash_liquidity.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity@FY2025}}.
Cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, a thinner buffer against a debt stack of {{total_debt@FY2025}}.
The TAV group's guarantee of part of the Antalya concession bank loan no longer exists at year-end following the refinancing of that loan.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2025}} to {{passengers@FY2025}}, a traffic growth rate of {{traffic_growth@FY2025}}.
Revenue grew by {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}}, faster than passenger volumes, reflecting the international airport portfolio as well as Paris traffic.
The renewed Ankara Esenboga concession took effect during the year, committing TAV Airports to capacity investment in exchange for long-dated operating rights.
